slides.title: Encapsulation
slides.prompt: Encapsulation is the practice of hiding data using private fields and providing public methods to access them. It protects data from unauthorized access.

slides.title: Private Keyword
slides.prompt: Which keyword makes a field private?

slides.title: Getter Method
options: A method that returns a field value
A method that sets a field value
A method that deletes a field
A method that creates a field
slides.correctAnswer: A method that returns a field value

slides.title: Setter Method
options: A method that sets a field value
A method that returns a field value
A method that deletes a field
A method that creates a field
slides.correctAnswer: A method that sets a field value
